title: BiRailLoftNode: add thickness parameter for watertight output
description: BiRailLoftNode produces an open surface sheet between two rail curves. The agent must manually add solidify_mesh after every bi_rail_loft, which it often forgets, producing non-watertight meshes. Add a thickness float parameter (default 0.001) that internally solidifies the loft surface. When thickness=0, output raw open surface for backward compat.
definition-of-done: 1. BiRailLoftNode has thickness float InputPort (default 0.001). 2. When thickness > 0, node internally solidifies surface (duplicate+offset+connect edges). 3. When thickness=0, outputs raw open surface. 4. Update mesh_context.py bi_rail_loft prompt and common pattern to mention thickness default.
testing-plan: 1. Write DSL: two rail curves + profile + bi_rail_loft (default thickness). 2. validate_dsl → mesh probe must show watertight=true. 3. Same DSL with thickness=0 → must show watertight=false (open surface). 4. Visual check in mesh viewer.
